title: Optimized protocols for RNA-induced silencing complex assembly and cleavage in cultured Drosophila cells
protocol: Culture Drosophila S2 cells in insect cell culture medium supplemented with penicillin-streptomycin and 10% FBS at 27°C.
Dilute confluent Drosophila S2 cells (∼1 × 10^7 cells/mL) and seed at a density of 5 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Seed S2 cells into a 10 cm dish with volumes of 10 mL at a density of 1 × 10^5 cells/mL for RNAi preparation.
Add 8 μg dsRNA targeting each gene (dcr-2, r2d2, ago2, or ago1 (3′-UTR)) to the cell culture medium and shake gently.
Transfer 1 mL of cells from the 10 cm dish to a 12-well plate for RNAi knockdown detection after 24 hours of dsRNA treatment.
Preheat Lipofectamine 2000 and Opti-MEM at room temperature (22°C–28°C).
Add 8 μg pAc5.1-Flag-AGO1 and 5 μg of pAc5.1-miR-9b plasmids to 500 μL Opti-MEM, and vortex the mixture.
Add 20 μL Lipofectamine 2000 to 500 μL Opti-MEM and vortex the mixture.
Add diluted plasmids to the diluted Lipofectamine 2000 mixture, then vortex.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add the plasmid-lipid complex dropwise to the cell medium of the 10 cm dish and shake gently to mix.
Design primers to perform qPCR.
Extract total RNA from S2 cells treated with dsRNAs by the Trizol method.
Prepare cDNA with the HiScript III Reverse Kit according to instructions and dilute to a volume of 100 μL.
Set up the qRT-PCR reaction system.
Run the real-time PCR instrument.
Calculate the efficiency of RNAi knockdown using the ΔΔCt method.
Collect S2 cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 min at 4°C after transfection.
Wash cells twice with cold PBS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL lysis buffer containing 2 mM DTT and protease inhibitor cocktail.
Transfer resuspended cells to a pre-chilled Dounce homogenizer.
Perform 50 strokes using the tight pestle on ice.
Clean the Douncer and pestle with lysis buffer three times between samples.
Clear the lysates by centrifugation at 15,000 g for 15 min at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant and aliquot 50 μl/tube.
Freeze the lysates using liquid nitrogen and store them at -80°C.
Incubate the mixture at 27°C for 40 min.
Load 3 μL of the assembly products into the 1.5% agarose native gel.
Wash the gel and the gel wells with 0.5 × TBE buffer before running.
Load 3 μL of 2 × RNA loading dye.
Perform electrophoresis at 300 V in cold 0.5 × TBE buffer for 20 min.
Sink the sample to the bottom of the wells using long pipet pips.
End the electrophoresis and keep the gel attached to the glass plate.
Perform phosphor imaging to detect the mature AGO1-RISC.
Harvest S2 cells by centrifugation at 500 g for 5 min.
Wash cells two times with cold PBS.
Add 1 mL of lysis buffer per 10 cm dish and resuspend the cell pellet by pipetting.
Incubate on ice for 10 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 15 min at 4°C.
Carefully transfer the supernatant to new tubes without disturbing the pellets.
Aliquot a 30 μL sample as the input fraction for western blot analysis.
Incubate supernatants with anti-AGO1 antibody or control IgG by rotation at 4°C for 5 hours or overnight (6–12 hours).
Wash protein A/G agarose beads once with 1 mL lysis buffer.
Add washed beads to lysates and incubate at 4°C for 3 hours on a rotator.
Wash samples three times with washing buffer.
Take an aliquot of 5 μL beads as the immunoprecipitation fraction for western blot analysis.
Prepare the in vitro RISC cleavage reaction mixture.
Incubate at 27°C for 2 hours.
Add 1 mL of Trizol reagent to the cleavage RNA sample.
Pipette the sample up and down several times to homogenize.
Incubate for 10 minutes to allow complete dissociation of the AGO1-RNA complex.
Add 0.2 mL of chloroform to 1 mL of Trizol.
Cap the tube and mix thoroughly by shaking.
Incubate at room temperature (22°C–28°C) for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the sample for 15 minutes at 13,000 g at 4°C.
Transfer 0.5 mL of the aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add 0.5 mL of 100% ethanol to the aqueous phase and mix well.
Proceed with the RNA Clean-up protocol of the ZYMO-Spin column.
Subject the cleaved fragment of substrate 1 to Qsep1 for size distribution analysis.
Subject the cleaved fragment of substrate 2 to gel electrophoresis analysis.
